name: Dashboard themes in the user folder are listed, chosen and drawn
step: Check user dashboard themes and their fallback to Default
rationale:
A pilot's own dashboard theme lives in SCRIPTS:/rfsuite.user/dashboard/<folder>/, which a
suite update leaves alone. lib/dashboard_themes.lua lists that folder for the theme pages and
resolves a stored "user/<folder>" choice; the shipped list moved there from the three tables
that each held a copy.

The harness serves fixtures/dashboard/ as the user folder through loadfile, io.open and
system.listFiles, with a listing that carries "..", a file and a folder name with a space.
Only folders with an init.lua are themes. A user theme's settings go to
[dashboard.user/<folder>], so a copy named like a shipped theme does not share its section.

The real widget is run once per stored theme, each in its own interpreter: a working user
theme is drawn from the user folder; one whose init.lua does not compile, one whose
preflight screen errors and one that is no longer on the card are each drawn as Default,
with no callback error and without reading the broken file again every frame. A stored
choice whose folder has gone is kept, so the theme comes back when the folder does.

--self-test takes out the "user/" source in the parser, the widget's init.lua fallback, its
state-screen fallback, the listing's init.lua test and the settings store's use of the
parser, one at a time, and requires a check to go red for each.
